document.abstract: The meeting held on 25 July titled “Revisit Classic Movie Sound” was held at the AMPAS Linwood Dunn Theater in Hollywood, CA. Approximately 140 members and guests were present to hear a unique presentation on the Fotoplayer by Joe Rinaudo as well as a discussion of movie stereo sound of the 1950s.
